decision: Price bands are computed on the catalog rate per million, blended across input and output, on the client
why: the catalog's `cost` is already per million (pi divides by 1,000,000 when it bills), so scaling it again in the client would have marked every model $$$
evidence: `priceMarks`: at or below 0 no mark, under 2 `$`, under 10 `$$`, else `$$$`; Claude Haiku 5.5 shows `$` and Fable 5 shows `$$$` in the picker

decision: Project settings is a dialog behind the top bar's more menu: name, goal, archive

decision: An opened thread widens the docked panel to 520

decision: The thread composer loses its dead paperclip, and the project composer requires attach

decision: Sources lists skipped versions with Unskip, and the Schedules screen's empty state uses the I4 pictogram

decision: A dialog's fields reset when it opens, instead of relying on the mount boundary
why: extracting the dialog shell moved `createPresence` inside `Dialog`, but both dialogs keep their state in always-mounted wrappers; a stale `created` project in New project would skip `project.create` and send the first message to the previous project, and a discarded goal edit survived a reopen

decision: The model picker's search asks the server (`models.list { query }`), not the 40-row page
why: the catalog holds about 1,592 models and the op caps a reply at 40, so an in-menu filter could only ever search the visible page and every model past it was unreachable
evidence: while it was a client filter, typing "haiku" returned "No model matches that" once the first page did not contain one; now typing "haiku" lists every Haiku row from opencode and the unkeyed providers, with `$` marks and `no key` on the greyed ones

decision: Menu failures and send failures keep separate error channels
why: the shared error card's Retry runs send or stop, so a failed `conv.configure` with text in the composer would have sent that text with the old model instead of retrying the pick
evidence: `choose()` writes `toolError`, drawn just above the toolbar with no Retry; the send/stop `error` card is unchanged
result: code path reviewed; both cards render from their own signal

decision: The toolbar's three controls share one trigger/popover component, and the model popup is a dialog with a real listbox
why: the preset, model and effort chips were three copies of the same anchor, popover and radio-row markup, and the model listbox contained the search field, labels and hard-coded unselected options, so a screen reader could not reach the current model or the reason a row is greyed
evidence: `ToolButton` and `ChoiceRow` in composer.tsx; the model popup is `role=dialog` with `role=listbox` and `role=group` labels, the current model is an `aria-selected` option, and a no-key row is `aria-disabled` (focusable, click ignored) instead of `disabled`
result: the preset menu still reports checked/disabled rows; the model search returns 40 options with `aria-disabled=true` on the unkeyed ones and clicking one leaves the chip unchanged

decision: The includeUnkeyed test asserts an unkeyed row, not only a superset
why: the first version could not fail when the flag was ignored; the fixture's built-in catalog does yield unkeyed models past the cap

decision: The client's structure, sizing and motion come from kiko; its colour comes from app.lighter.xyz

decision: Primary action is white; orange stays reserved for waiting

result: browser check of Home, sidebar and waiting cards after the sweep

decision: Fonts are kiko's Satoshi, Fraunces and JetBrains Mono, self-hosted from kiko's licensed files

decision: Radii and type were swept mechanically to kiko's scale rather than restyled per screen
why: 63 files carried 161 2px radii and 10 type sizes; a per-file pass would have drifted, while one mapping keeps every surface on the same scale
result: census after the sweep: 162 rounded-[8px], 65 rounded-[12px], no 2px radii left

decision: Menus and nav lists slide one fill instead of repainting rows
why: kiko's menu and settings nav glide the hover fill; copying the behaviour gives the hover a single continuous surface and avoids per-row background transitions
evidence: components/ui/glide.tsx (GlideList, MenuItem, MenuSurface) places an absolutely positioned mark from pointer, focus, active value and resize; .glide-mark transitions transform and size over 160ms --ease-kiko
result: composer menus and the settings nav use it; the mark jumps without animation when a list resizes or an active value moves it

decision: The model picker is a 400x392 anchored panel with a provider rail, pin favourites and keyboard movement
why: the owner asked for kiko's model picker; it also fixes the flat 40-row menu, where providers were only a trailing word and the current model could not be reached from the keyboard
evidence: components/chat/model-picker.tsx: 48px provider rail, server search, 36px rows with price marks and no-key, pin glyph (never a star, per the identity rule), animated check, Arrow/Enter and aria-activedescendant
result: composer opens it; query still goes to models.list { query }

decision: Settings became a 1240x820 surface with a 240px nav, 34px glide rows and 12px cards
why: the owner asked for settings/* to follow kiko's layout; the old route was a full-bleed two-column page at 232px with flat rows

decision: The composer is a 16px raised box with 32px round footer controls and upward menus
why: the owner asked for kiko's composer; the old box was a square 12px with square 32px controls and pipe separators
evidence: components/chat/composer.tsx: rounded-[16px] box, 15/24 textarea, attach/preset/model/effort text controls, 32px round send, MenuSurface for preset and effort, ModelPicker for models

decision: cursor.com/agents could not be read; its public cloud page supplied the composition instead
why: /agents is disallowed by cursor.com/robots.txt and redirects to authenticator.cursor.sh; bypassing either would be wrong, so the public /cloud page and its bundle were read

decision: One Segmented primitive draws every tab strip and range switch
why: extensions, the usage range and the project panel each measured the active tab with its own code, and the panel's pill had drifted invisible; a shared component removes the drift and the duplicate measurement
evidence: components/ui/segmented.tsx: 34px line-edged fill track, one absolute selected pill measured from offsetLeft/offsetWidth and re-measured on resize, role=group with aria-pressed on each button
result: extensions.tsx, settings/usage.tsx and chat/panel.tsx consume it; the panel pill is visible again at 1440 and 390

decision: Inputs are exported field variants, not a field class string copied per screen
why: ten screens carried their own copy of the same border, ground, inset highlight and hover/focus steps, so focus drew a ring on some screens and a border on others, and textarea variants added fragile h-auto overrides on top of FIELD
evidence: components/ui/field.ts exports FIELD, MONO_FIELD, FIELD_AREA, MONO_AREA and FIELD_ROW; onboarding, sign-in, add-from-URL, discover, installed, presets, skills, config form, profile and quiet hours consume them, and no site appends a conflicting height or font size

decision: A pictogram's accent is orange, never the near-white accent
why: the Lighter port made --color-accent near-white, so the pictogram accent vanished against the raised ground; the canvas keeps one orange detail per illustration
evidence: app.css .pictogram .a and .af use --color-waiting; spec 14-client states it
result: empty states read again at 1440 and 390; white stays the primary button

decision: The model picker's rail is 112px of full provider names, not 48px of codes

decision: The add-from-URL sheet uses the dialog surface, and its close is a 28px target like a dialog's

decision: The tab strip is a group of pressed buttons, not a tablist
why: three consumers switch a route, a range and a pane; none owns a tabpanel, and the component had no roving tabindex or arrow keys, so role=tablist announced a pattern it could not drive
evidence: components/ui/segmented.tsx: role=group with aria-pressed per button, same sliding pill; consumers unchanged

decision: Menus and the model picker take their surface from `float`; cards take `panel`
why: MenuSurface carried both `float` (radius 12) and `rounded-[8px]`, and the composer's picker and the two card shells copied the recipe, so the radius depended on Tailwind's emitted order and the recipes could drift
evidence: app.css @utility panel (line edge, radius-card, surface) used by settings Group and extensions Panel; glide MenuSurface and the picker shell carry `float` only; spec 14-client names 12px menus
result: measured: menu 12px and 10% edge, picker 12px and 10% edge, settings cards unchanged

decision: Enter on a model's pin no longer picks that model
why: the option row listened for Enter/Space, so the keydown from the nested pin button bubbled up and selected the model while the user meant to pin it; the search input already owns Arrow/Enter for the listbox

result: focused pin + Enter leaves the picker open with 40 options; no model change

decision: Unused scale tokens and dead utilities were deleted rather than documented
why: the radius, spacing and type tokens had no consumers: editing --text-row or --spacing-control changed nothing, while components wrote the same values as arbitrary utilities; a scale that cannot change anything is not a source of truth
evidence: app.css keeps radius micro/control/card/pop/full and text section/title (read by type-page/type-section and panel/float); spacing scale and the rest of the type scale removed; the 320px .settings-control width rule and unused field/glide-target utilities removed; 14-client §Theme now says the remaining values are written where they are used
